Mammoth Padlockable Barrel Bolt for Heavy Duty Uses

text.description_html:
Global GH-832BB8-GV, Oversized Barrel Bolt

Extra large, the 8 inch Padlockable Barrel Bolt is ideal for locking up your shed, warehouse, and other heavy duty, important doors where a regularly sized barrel bolt just won't do. The Oversized Barrel Bolt has a massive 9/16 inch diameter bolt for extra security. The zinc plating is for rust resistance. Due to its heavy duty construction, it is great for harsh conditions. It comes packaged with the necessary mounting hardware.

Also Available: Oversized 5 Inch Padlockable Barrel Bolt

Features and Specifications of the Extra Large Heavy Duty Zinc Barrel Bolt:

  • Finish: Zinc Plated
  • Overall Length with Guide: 8"
  • Bolt Throw: 2"
  • Bolt Diameter: 9/16"
  • Mounting Plate Length: 6"
  • Mounting Plate Width: 2-11/16"
  • Overall Bolt Length: 7"
  • Guide Length: 2-23/32"
  • Guide Width: 1-15/32"
  • Guide Projection: 1"
  • Overall Strike Length: 1-29/32"
  • Overall Strike Width: 1-31/32"
  • Rust Resistant
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware, guide plate, and strike.

Sold Individually
